objective: A complete first World 1-1 PPO experiment with saved model and matched before/after evaluation.
device_choice: Short 2048-decision learning checks: CPU one thread 163.11/s, CPU four threads 162.51/s, MPS 152.73/s. These include startup effects and are close; CPU one thread selected.
evaluation_policy: stochastic actions with explicit fixed seeds; fresh simulator reset; no updates
hypothesis: Training may increase typical distance reached. Level completion is a stretch goal, not assumed.
checkpoint_policy: Atomic latest checkpoint every60seconds, archived checkpoint every300seconds, final model saved on completion.
selection: Report the final time-budget checkpoint, not a checkpoint picked after seeing final evaluation scores.
baseline: Untrained PPO network, identical environment preprocessing and action set to final evaluation.
limitations: One training seed and three evaluation trials are not strong statistical evidence.
Different reset seeds do not create new Mario levels; sampled actions create variation in these trials.
